outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrograph images of cells during photoactivation, not a plot showing averaged data, so the check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time (with fitted model curves) and insets showing averaged early time-point responses with error bars as time-series curves. These are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays since the raw data points are already the plotted series, and overlaying additional individual replicate points would clutter these dense time-course curves.
